impact.affected_asset: The FLAG constant embedded in the application source; the separate mounted flag fixture is not shown to be read by the application.
impact.attacker_capability: Register a schema, obtain its returned UUID route, and use the associated serializer to project a property whose name originates from the server-side FLAG constant.
impact.security_effect: Disclosure of the server-held FLAG constant through a schema-controlled serialized response.

causal_trace.summary: The registration handler receives an HTTP request body and shallow-merges its fields into the server's default response schema.

The resulting schema, including requester-provided fields, is supplied to the SerializerSelector-derived factory and the compiled serializer is retained for later use, allowing the requester to control response projection configuration.
On a UUID lookup, the retrieval route invokes the requester-associated serializer on an object whose sole computed property name is the server-side FLAG value and whose value is "congratulations".

Because serialization output is controlled by the registered schema while the serialized object contains a server-held property name, a schema that selects that property can disclose the server-held FLAG string through the HTTP response.

failure.operation: Invocation of a requester-registered compiled serializer on {[FLAG]: 'congratulations'} in GET /whowilldothis/:uid.

primary_invariant.statement: A response serializer applied to an object containing a secret-derived property name must use a fixed server-owned schema rather than schema fields supplied by the requester.
primary_invariant.violated_because: POST /register merges req.body into the schema passed to the serializer compiler, saves that requester-associated serializer, and the lookup route uses it to serialize an object keyed by FLAG.

quality.review_notes: The primary source establishes the schema-to-compiled-serializer-to-secret-keyed-object dataflow, but no exploit payload, response trace, library-semantics artifact, test execution, organizer solution, or patch is supplied. The source comment saying registration is internal is not enforcement evidence; proxy configuration is not available for review. The flag fixture contains FLAG{test}, but index.js does not read that file, so it is not evidence that the fixture is exposed.

remediation.invariant_restored: Do not compile or retain requester-controlled schemas for later serialization of objects containing secret-derived keys; serialize such objects only through a fixed server-owned projection.
mitigation_classes: separate secret-bearing data from requester-configurable serialization
